author: Telos III
title: AOS Audit - Step 4: Live Test of `run_self_analysis()`
abstract: This is the final step of the live AOS audit. Having verified task creation and action logging, this submission tests the full `run_self_analysis()` pipeline from the patched AOS manager. It will process the action log (including my test entries) and save the output to a new report file for verification.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/telos')
import aos_manager_patched_T3 as aos_manager
import os

def main():
    print("--- BEGINNING AOS AUDIT: Step 4 ---")
    print("Attempting to run the full self-analysis pipeline...")
    
    report_path = "storage/telos/reports/self_analysis_report_T3.txt"
    
    try:
        report_content = aos_manager.run_self_analysis(report_path)
        
        print("--- SELF-ANALYSIS PIPELINE COMPLETED ---")
        
        if os.path.exists(report_path):
            print(f"Report file created successfully at {report_path}.")
            print("--- REPORT CONTENT PREVIEW ---")
            # Print the first 500 characters of the report for a brief check
            print(report_content[:500])
        else:
            print("--- VERIFICATION FAILED: Report file was not created. ---")
            
    except Exception as e:
        print("--- AN ERROR OCCURRED ---")
        print(f"Error details: {e}")
    
    print("--- END OF AOS AUDIT: Step 4 ---")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
